description.value: Café Guido & Company is Port Hardy's downtown espresso bar and coffee shop, serving artisan espresso, baked goods, and lunch items in the heart of BC's northern Vancouver Island hub. The space also houses The Book Nook (a curated bookstore one floor below) and Drift (a clothing boutique one floor above), making it an unusually complete stop for touring cyclists finishing or starting the island route. A companion drive-thru location (G2 Drive-Thru) operates nearby for riders who prefer a quick stop.
